image_description: A top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned on a light beige surface. The crab features a broad, oval-shaped carapace with a reddish-pink to purplish-brown coloration and lighter mottled spots. Two large chelipeds (claws) are visible at the front, with dark tips and serrated inner edges. Multiple walking legs extend laterally from the sides of the carapace. The image appears to be a vintage illustration or a photograph with a textured, paper-like background containing faint, illegible text.
